The Fel Ork Waaagh has hit MWG and it’s up to ALL of the Space Wolf heroes of legend to stop them in their tracks. 

Nathan joins us today with is WoW inspired Orkz for a 2,000 point game against Luka and the Space Wolves running nearly all named characters.
